title: Cheezy fabric melts-poor quality-save your money
text:
Cheezy fabric melts-poor quality-save your money. This fits my large ironing board just fine. I was very disappointed in the quality of the fabric. After very light use
you can see in this photo how the fabric is coming apart. This is on a low setting. Don't waste your money.

product_metadata.title: Minky Homecare SmartFit Supersize Reflector Ironing Board Cover with Heat Reflective Surface, 57" x 21", White/Multicolor
features: CUSTOM FIT IRONING BOARD REPLACEMENT COVER – Upgrade your existing ironing board for better performance or replace a lost or worn-out cover. 2-in-1 Cover and Pad Fits all extra-large ironing boards from 48 x 15 to 55 x 18 inches.
PREMIUM IRONING BOARD COVER AND PAD – The Reflector Ironing Board Cover from Minky features a metallic surface that reflects heat back through the fabric for faster crease removal.
SMOOTH IRONING SURFACE - The extra-thick felt pad provides a smooth ironing surface. The dual-layer 1-piece laminated cover and pad ensure no bumps, ridges, or wrinkles as you iron.
HOLDS FAST AND FIRMLY – Fits in seconds thanks to super-tight, pretensioned elastic for a fast and secure fit.
MADE IN THE UK - Minky ironing board covers are manufactured in the UK to a high-quality production standard.
description: Minky’s SmartFit Reflector Ironing Board Cover is designed to fit extra-large ironing boards. This replacement cover can be fitted with ease and speed. The super-tight, pretensioned elastic edging ensures a perfect fit on all boards from 48 x 15 inches up to 55 x 18 inches. Designed with a metallic surface which reflects heat back through the fabric for faster crease removal, the luxuriously thick felt backing provides a super smooth ironing surface to optimize your ironing comfort. Minky ironing board covers are manufactured in the UK to a high-quality production standard.   CLEANING INSTRUCTIONS: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Do not machine wash. Do not bleach. Do not tumble dry. Allow to dry naturally.
